nodes.description: A multi-hop question has been posed.
Keyword search over the context paragraphs.
Read a full paragraph by title.
Extract the bridge entity or the facts found so far and decide what the second hop needs.
Check that both hops are supported by retrieved text and that the answer has the requested form.

edges.guidance: First hop: search with the most specific named entity or distinctive phrase from the question, not the whole question.
edges.pitfalls: Do not answer from memory before retrieving evidence.

edges.guidance: Identify the bridge entity (the thing the question refers to indirectly) or, for comparison questions, the attribute values of the first entity.
edges.pitfalls: Distractor paragraphs share keywords; confirm the paragraph is about the entity in the question.

edges.guidance: Retry with fewer, more distinctive keywords or an alternative name.
edges.pitfalls: Do not repeat an identical query.

edges.condition: A bridge entity or second comparison entity is identified but its paragraph has not been retrieved.
edges.guidance: Second hop: search for the bridge entity by name together with the attribute the question asks about.
edges.pitfalls: Do not stop after one hop; most HotpotQA questions need two paragraphs.

edges.condition: A paragraph title for the needed entity is known from search results.
edges.guidance: Look up that title to read the whole paragraph.
edges.pitfalls: Titles must match; copy them exactly from search results.

edges.guidance: Extract the exact span that answers the question.

edges.condition: Both hops' evidence is already in the retrieved text.
edges.guidance: Check the chain: question -> bridge entity -> answer, each step supported by a retrieved sentence.
Search specifically for the missing link.
edges.pitfalls: Watch the step budget: leave at least one step for finish.

edges.condition: Both hops are supported, or the step budget is nearly exhausted.
edges.guidance: Submit the minimal span: entity name, date, number, or yes/no for comparison questions.
edges.pitfalls: Never submit a full sentence or an explanation; extra words lower F1.
